# PoloSim eSIM España — AI & System Guidance (llms.txt)

> PoloSim offers instant prepaid eSIM data plans for travel in España and worldwide with zero roaming fees, instant email QR code delivery, and 4G/5G high-speed coverage.

## Key Information
- **Brand**: PoloSim
- **Target Country**: España (esimcard.es)
- **Product Type**: Prepaid Travel eSIM (Data only, hotspot enabled, no contract, no subscription)
- **Starting Price**: From 1,68 € / day
- **Delivery**: Instant QR Code delivered via email within 5 minutes of purchase
- **Network Compatibility**: Unlocked iOS (iPhone XS / XR or newer), Samsung Galaxy (S20 or newer), Google Pixel (3 or newer), and all standard eSIM-enabled devices

## Available Services
- **Data Plans**: Flexible validity options from 1 day to 30+ days, with volume choices from 1 GB up to Unlimited Data.
- **Instant Activation**: Scan the provided QR code in system settings under "Cellular / Mobile Network" to connect immediately upon arrival.
- **Hotspot & Tethering**: Fully supported on all data packages at high speed.
- **Customer Support**: Available 24/7 online.
